rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase 2026-2027
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase is set to 1.6% from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Applies to rent-controlled units in San Francisco.

rules.exemptions: Units not subject to rent control.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board Annual Rent Increase Announcement
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
